Accredited private institutions, as defined in section 20 256.183, have expressed a desire to avoid competition in the 21 area of higher education. 22 2. Under Iowa law, accredited private institutions may 23 offer academic programs that result in the conferring of an 24 associate degree. 25 3. Under Iowa law, community colleges established under 26 chapter 260C are not authorized to offer academic programs that 27 result in the conferring of a bachelor’s degree. 28 4.
